steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each hour needs an approval, each invoice must match its recomputed amount, and each placement must clear the margin floor.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 invoice differs from its recomputed amount

findings.title: Invoice differs from its recomputed amount
findings.fix: Correct the invoice before it is sent

findings.title: Margin below the floor
findings.fix: Review the rate with the client

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

       Fix: Correct the invoice before it is sent.
[medium] timesheet-b.csv:19  Hour with no approval.
       Fix: Get the approval before billing.
[medium] margin.csv:26  Margin below the floor.
       Fix: Review the rate with the client.
Not checked: Whether the hours were worked.
pros: Checks an invoice that differs from its recomputed amount, an hour with no approval, and a margin below the floor.
cons: Not checked: Whether the hours were worked.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-contract-staffing-billing skill on the records for this review.
